## Deviations and findings recorded before the round was stopped
- **§3 heig-alloc is degenerate on this model.** r90 ranges over 26–3885, so the cap that meets 0.148 bits is 8, and it binds in all 112 layers: heig-alloc equals heig-8. The rank-8 share of a layer's Hessian-weighted error has a median of 2%; it is 51% in block 2 qkv. A greedy share-per-bit fallback was computed (`alloc_greedy.json`) and rejected before running: shares are scale-free, so it spent most bits on attn.proj (cheap, low importance). An importance-weighted version was planned. No §3 arm ran.
- **§4 asymmetric target, literal form is broken.** At block 0, where x̃ = x and so C = H exactly, W·C·(H + 0.01·mean diag·I)⁻¹ moved W by 40% (‖W̃ − W‖/‖W‖ = 0.40). The damping is large next to most of H's eigenvalues, because a few massive channels dominate the mean diagonal. The correction form W̃ = W + W(C − H)(H + damp)⁻¹ reduces to W exactly when C = H; on blocks 0–1 its drift matches heig-8's. Only a 2-block smoke test ran; its artifacts were deleted. No §4 arm ran.
- §5–§8 did not start.
